data.name: Amrjit
data.gender_notes: Amrjit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amr means immortal or everlasting and Jit means victory or conqueror. The name Amrjit carries the meaning “Immortal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi. Parents who choose Amrjit usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have conquered their inner demons and strive for immortality through spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Amrjit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amrjit total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Amrjit holds immense cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is a profound testament to the Hindu belief in the eternal nature of the divine. The name signifies the ongoing triumph of the divine over the temporal and the impermanent. It's a name that resonates strongly with the Hindu ethos of remembering and celebrating the divine and the eternal even amidst the transient nature of everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Amrjit reflects the Hindu quest for immortality or spiritual enlightenment. The name Amrjit implies the victory of the immortal self (Atman) over the finite, mortal self (Anatman), and the ultimate conquest of the divine within. It's a name that inspires a person to strive for spiritual growth and to seek the eternal truths hidden within oneself and the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Amrjit: Radiating with the nectar of immortal bliss. Embodying the divine joy that transcends worldly sorrows.
